kindTools.both: The name "{name}" is used by both: {kinds} (a name goes to one kind only. Rename one of them with name in kind_update)
kindTools.create.nameInTarget: The name goes in target (leave {key} out of value, or give it the same name as target)
kindTools.create.ofNeeded: kind_create's value needs of (which list the kind is of: card, section or line)
kindTools.create.ofShape: of is one of card, section, line (given: {of})
kindTools.delete.builtin: The kind "{name}" is a built-in {kind}, so it cannot be removed
kindTools.delete.targetNeeded: Give the name of the kind to remove as the target of kind_delete (an array for several)
kindTools.delete.valueKey: kind_delete's value cannot have "{key}" (only dryRun can be written)
kindTools.line.builtinReset: Reset the {label} of built-in {kind} {name} to default
kindTools.line.viasChanged: Changed the via values of the built-in card kind flow
kindTools.line.viasReset: Reset the via values of the built-in card kind flow to the built-in ones only
kindTools.none: No such kind: "{names}" (kind_list lists the kinds there are)
kindTools.read.valueKey: kind_read's value cannot have "{key}" (only after and limit can be written, when reading all with no target. The kinds to read go in target)
kindTools.taken: The kind "{name}" already exists (a {kind}). A name goes to one kind only
kindTools.takenBuiltin: The kind "{name}" already exists (a built-in {kind}). A name goes to one kind only
kindTools.target.one: Give one kind name (a string) as the target of {tool}
kindTools.update.builtinFlow: Only context (what it is for and when to use it) and vias (the array of value names added to the via of nodes) can be changed on a built-in {kind} ({key} cannot be changed)
kindTools.update.builtinOther: Only context (what it is for and when to use it) can be changed on a built-in {kind} ({key} cannot be changed)
kindTools.update.builtinSections: Only context (what it is for and when to use it) and icon (the mark in the navigator: {name, color}) can be changed on a built-in {kind} ({key} cannot be changed)
kindTools.update.nameKey: A rename is written as name in value ({key} cannot be written)
kindTools.update.nameShape: name is the new name (a string)
kindTools.update.nothing: Nothing to change (a key of the definition, name or renames. For a built-in kind: context; for a built-in section kind: icon too)
kindTools.update.ofFixed: of (which list a kind is of) cannot be changed (to make it another kind, make it again with kind_create)
kindTools.update.renameItem: renames[{i}] is one of {field, to}, {row, to} or {row, field, to}
kindTools.update.renameKind: The name of a {kind} cannot be changed yet (make it again with kind_create, move what uses it, then remove the old one with kind_delete)
kindTools.update.renamesCardsOnly: renames (rename fields and rows, moving their values) works on card kinds only
kindTools.update.renamesKind: renames[{i}]: the kind is given by target and name (kind and top_section cannot be written. To rename a section directly under the root, use renames of project_update)
kindTools.update.renamesShape: renames is an array of [{field, to}, {row, to}, {row, field, to}]
kindTools.vias.removeAmong: "{gone}" in the remove of vias is not among the values this project added (there are: {have})
kindTools.vias.removeNone: "{gone}" in the remove of vias is not among the values this project added (there are: none)
kindTools.vias.shape: vias is an array of via value names (replacing the current ones) or {"add": [...], "remove": [...]} (adding to or removing from the current ones). null goes back to the built-in values only
